problem_type: reversible Canvas write authority and lifecycle split
symptom: Approving set_node_prompt in the Canvas assistant can mutate Canvas through applyProposalBatch before Project Agent Host durably records and claims the exact proposal, while decline, cancel, timeout, unsupported, stale, and unavailable paths can lose their distinct reason in boolean or free-form results.
direct_cause: CanvasAssistantPanel currently combines approval intent with direct domain execution and returns the renderer-minted proposalId only after mutation; the Host coordinator persists approval afterward and recomputes a narrower action hash. Outcome adapters independently flatten lifecycle reasons instead of committing one Host status projection.
class_root: Nomi lacks one enforced admission boundary from main-minted verified invocation through durable Host proposal identity to the existing Canvas receipt, and lacks one atomic reduction from typed capability outcome to every Host record. Any renderer-owned approval callback or boolean confirmation adapter can therefore execute before authority is durable or erase the reason needed for safe recovery.
affected_population: Users approving set_node_prompt or later reversible Canvas proposals from the embedded/Pi Canvas assistant
Users who decline, stop, time out, switch projects, lose the Canvas Surface, or restart between approval, receipt commit, and Host terminal projection
Future MCP callers if canvas.write were exposed before the verified project-session lease and Registry-derived adapter are complete
entry_points: ProjectAgentExecutionCoordinator tool decision and proposal persistence
Canvas Surface target capture, revalidation, and write dispatch
applyProposalBatch receipt prepare, mutation, commit, abort, and restart disposition
Pi/renderer confirmation decline, stop, timeout, malformed reply, and Surface loss
future Registry-derived MCP canvas.write adapter after Phase 5 lease cutover

external_sources.purpose: Confirms accept, decline, and cancel are distinct protocol actions and must not be collapsed into one boolean confirmation result.
Confirms transport cancellation stops processing and is not a normal tool response; the Host still needs an internal durable diagnostic/outcome projection without exposing an ordinary MCP result.

invariants: User approval records intent only; no Canvas Surface dispatch or mutation occurs until main durably stores and reads back a claimed Host proposal containing the exact verified target, preconditions, policyRevision, inputHash, actionHash, and main-preallocated receiptProposalId.

The existing Canvas committed-proposal/receipt carries immutable hostApprovalId and hostActionHash, and main admits or recovery-terminalizes it only when binding, receiptProposalId, approvalId, and actionHash exactly match the durable Host proposal.

A missing, reused, or mismatched receipt never terminalizes success and never redispatches Canvas mutation; it persists capability_receipt_unresolved as failed and non-retryable while retaining evidence for manual review.

The renderer supplies only owner-bound raw Canvas evidence. Main canonicalizes and hashes it; the renderer synchronously revalidates the same evidence inside canvasWriteBoundary immediately before the existing applyProposalBatch transaction.

Every non-success capability outcome uses one closed code mapping and one durable Host commit so the terminal Turn, queue item, ProjectAgentFailureItem, and any existing ProjectAgentProposalItem have identical status and retryable values.

Migrating set_node_prompt removes its hand-written Pi schema, allowed-set, approval/effect, and direct-dispatch owners while preserving applyCanvasToolCall, proposalTxn, receipt, reconcile, and Undo as the only Canvas domain transaction.

recurrence.reason: The same missing admission and outcome invariants are reachable from every reversible Canvas operation and every confirmation transport, across restarts, Surface replacement, project switching, and future callers; observing one alias does not constrain the mechanism to one case.
same_class_scan: Searched CanvasAssistantPanel, applyProposalBatch/proposalUndo, ProjectAgentExecutionCoordinator, ProposalApprovalRef, ProjectAgentProposalReceipt, canvasDescriptors, agentChatPolicy, gate TOOL_META, mcpProtocol, gateway, core, and spendConfirm for proposalId, actionHash, approval, cancelled, and confirmation ownership.
Confirmed set_node_prompt, connect_edges, create_nodes, and tidy share the same Canvas proposal transaction class; only set_node_prompt is the first migration slice.

Confirmed MCP 2025-11-25 elicitation distinguishes accept/decline/cancel while current adapters contain boolean cancellation paths; MCP canvas.write remains unexposed until Phase 5 rather than receiving a partial repair.
Confirmed document.write already freezes document anchor/revision/hash and is retained as a regression sentinel, not rewritten as a Canvas state owner.

prevention.strategy: Enforce authority at the earliest shared boundaries: a Registry-owned canvas.write contract and main-minted verified invocation, exact Host-to-existing-receipt correlation checked by main, synchronous in-boundary Canvas revalidation, atomic typed-outcome reduction, and same-batch deletion of the migrated Pi owners.

migration: New Host-driven canvas.write proposals use a versioned approval shape with receiptProposalId, policyRevision, inputHash, and actionHash. Existing terminal proposal items remain immutable history. A live legacy proposal lacking those fields cannot resume or dispatch and becomes a durable manual-review failure. Existing Canvas receipts without hostApprovalId/hostActionHash remain readable for their historical Undo/display behavior but can never terminalize a new Host canvas.write proposal. applyProposalBatch may mint an ID only for preserved non-Host operations until each alias migrates and deletes that caller; Host calls must inject the preallocated identity.
residual_risks: connect_edges, create_nodes, and tidy remain on their legacy Pi admission path until their subsequent Phase 3C slices; the owner gate must keep the exception explicit and shrinking.
MCP canvas.write remains unavailable until Phase 5 provides the verified project-session lease, Registry projection, and protocol-specific cancellation behavior.
Packaged GUI crash journeys are deferred to the final candidate; this slice relies on deterministic coordinator, receipt, boundary, and restart tests plus the Phase 3C focused matrix.
